purpose: Try the complete EDD procedure on five task flows before expanding coverage.
scope: Five desktop child variants only, not full family or release qualification.

variants.task: Open the signed-out app and reach Sign in
Send a first prompt and verify the reply after reload
Ask a follow-up using the intended thread context
Read multiple streaming updates while preserving the reading anchor
Stop a streaming reply and submit a new prompt without stale replacement

stopOn: Any missing preparation or semantic-review prerequisite
Any unapproved request or budget overrun
execution.cleanup: Close only owned contexts; retain all attempt evidence and test-owned conversation identities. No automatic resend or deletion.

deferred: All55 unselected catalog flows and unselected child variants; not prerequisites for this pilot and not counted as passed.
